nodes.name: ChatGPT

nodes.name: Claude Code

nodes.name: CodeGraph

nodes.name: Codex CLI

nodes.name: Git
nodes.summary: Version control CLI that owns commits, refs, worktrees and the common directory.

nodes.name: GitHub

nodes.name: Herdr
nodes.summary: Terminal multiplexer server that hosts task-agent and review panes.

nodes.name: npm Registry

nodes.name: Developer host

nodes.name: Agent host

nodes.name: CLI process
nodes.summary: One short bun process per repo-harness command from a user shell or Bot.

nodes.name: Herdr server
nodes.summary: External Herdr server that owns panes and runs pane commands.

nodes.name: Hook process
nodes.summary: One short bun process per host hook event; reads stdin JSON and answers on stdout.

nodes.name: MCP coding shell
nodes.summary: Detached sh -c session that the MCP server starts for coding tools; at most four run, each for at most 30 minutes.

nodes.name: MCP server
nodes.summary: Long-running repo-harness mcp serve process on stdio or loopback HTTP.

nodes.name: OAR review host
nodes.summary: Node process in a Herdr pane that runs one review session for at most three rounds.

nodes.name: Operator collector
nodes.summary: Detached fleet, task-read and setup-check child processes, the resident git cat-file worker of each registered repository that resolves to one GitHub remote and a valid default-branch ref, and the gh, herdr, MCP doctor and package-manager probes of the background collectors; GET handlers read only their cached results.

nodes.name: Operator server

nodes.name: Process group launcher

nodes.name: Process supervisor
nodes.summary: Bounded supervisor that publishes the process group id before it starts the target and terminates the group on timeout, signal or parent exit.

nodes.name: Vendor reviewer CLI
nodes.summary: Claude or Codex reviewer runtime under sandbox-exec, started by the OAR review host.
